plain_english: Sequence which space-time-self, difference-life — of knowings from separation — this of-knower makes-varied-appearance.
sanskrit_cite: kramo yo deśakālātmā bhedaprāṇas | sa saṃvidām vicchedād eṣa vijñātur vicitrābhāsatākṛtaḥ

plain_english: Of both — there indeed way: pure, impure, self — from difference — purity of externalized objects — in I-ness immersion.
sanskrit_cite: ubhayo tatra vai rītiḥ śuddhāśuddhātmabhedataḥ | śuddhir bahiṣkṛtārthānāṃ svāhantāyāṃ nimajjanam

plain_english: Impurity too of the immersed — not thus heart-rest — in-between too infinite are states by-degrees.
sanskrit_cite: aśuddhir api magnānāṃ naivaṃ hṛdayaviśramaḥ | atrāntare 'py anantās syuḥ sthitayas tāratamyataḥ

plain_english: Of proper-measured knowers in manifestation — common; otherwise-states divided — subject of-object.
sanskrit_cite: ucitocitameyānāṃ pramātṝṇāṃ prakāśane sādhāraṇānyathābhāvau | bhidyete mātṛmeyayoḥ

plain_english: Thought-free, clear appearance — that creation of Shambhu held — by non-difference, in self-creation, own-self indeed made-instrument.
sanskrit_cite: avikalpasphuṭābhāsā sā sṛṣṭiḥ śāmbhavī matā | abhedenātmanirmāṇe svātmaiva karaṇīkṛtaḥ

plain_english: Action, knowledge, self, consciousness, power — from difference-threading-cause — kalā, vidyā, stage reached — in difference-undifference again becomes.
sanskrit_cite: kriyājñānātmacicchaktir bhedāsūtraṇakāraṇāt | kalāvidyāpadaṃ prāpya bhedodbhede punar bhavet

plain_english: Means-of-knowledge, intellect, multitudes — which of action imaginations — that indeed cut, cut — action, knowledge, effort — when.
sanskrit_cite: pramāṇabuddhiprakarā yatkriyāyā vikalpanāḥ | saiva vicchinnavicchinnakriyā jñānodyamā yadā
